manual_steps: Prepare a fresh isolated positive fixture from the actual macOS shell build receipt; use its printed non-secret synthetic input only.

Launch the real application through the fixture wrapper. In its visible main window replace the existing textarea with that exact input, click Add to queue and Process next; do not Collect results. Capture the visible processed state and quit the entire application (Cmd+Q on macOS).

Wait for the wrapper to record actual process exit. Launch the same binary with the same root again. Click Collect results; visually verify the same task ID and exact uppercase input, then click Collect results again and verify no second delivery. Capture the visible result and quit fully.

For an independent delete-store-control fixture repeat the first GUI session. After actual process exit, run only its guarded delete-store command. Restart the app, click Collect results, capture its empty result state and quit. The persistence retrieval oracle must fail with the exact classifier.

Attach both captures per case with the capture subcommand. A human records attributable macOS GUI observations, actual timestamps/app identity and process termination in the generated observation document. Backend traces and classifier output alone cannot certify GUI operation.

Retain all three native OS build receipts plus positive/negative macOS traces, raw logs, screenshots and attributable operator observation for independent OA-18 review. Linux/Windows runtime support is not claimed without corresponding actual launches.

source_facts.ipc: A Tauri command can receive the actual invoking WebviewWindow and managed State; no frontend invoke or layout change is needed.
source_facts.page_load: Builder.on_page_load supplies Webview and PageLoadPayload with actual URL and Finished event; the fixture records it, but this alone is not visual evidence.
source_facts.assets: Pinned context code embeds frontendDist when devUrl is absent; this example has no devUrl, so native debug cargo build contains the incumbent assets.
source_facts.isolation: Context.config_mut and WindowConfig.incognito select nonpersistent webview storage only for explicit isolated fixtures; normal UI/config is preserved.
source_facts.macos: Native tauri-driver has no WKWebView driver; supported newer embedded WebDriver integrations require extra plugins. None is installed or added here; an attributable manual GUI protocol is used.
source_facts.windows: MSVC C++ build tools and the Windows SDK are build prerequisites; actual runtime additionally requires WebView2. tauri-build2.7.4 explicitly requires an ICO resource; icon.ico wraps the unchanged existing PNG bytes. No settings or runtime installed here.
source_facts.linux: Preinstalled WebKitGTK4.1, GTK3, OpenSSL development packages and native compiler/linker are required; no apt or host installation is performed.

source_limitations: Microsoft ICO article search excerpt was available but full article returned HTTP403; the actual little-endian ICO header/directory and PNG payload format were read in Chromium's primary ico_tools.py source. No icon renderer or Windows resource compiler executed.
limits: All builds and GUI actions are deferred to the complete phase boundary. Build-only/queue-service-only/trace-only evidence cannot prove GUI. Native computer APIs are disabled in this session. No test root or store has been created or deleted by authoring this protocol.
